svg.title: Research: Self-Learning Hybrid Load Balancing: A Numerical Thrift Approach for Virtualized HPC
svg.desc: IEEE CONECCT 2026. Bhavya M, Dhruv Agrawal, Chitranshu Ajmera, Ayush Jain, Nishit Das. TL;DR: Treat numerical precision as a load-balancing knob: when moving data costs more than computing it, compute less precisely instead of migrating. Results: 1.215× peak speedup, 8 ranks, 4–16 MPI ranks, WSL2, <0.125 Navier–Stokes residual.
